title: Literature check: the reacting thermals are a population-level variant of known self-drifting, self-fragmenting flame balls; spatial sorting (selection by arrival) is an untried route to C:minority-swimmers-spread
summary: Opened 7 sources. Combustion theory (Yanez/Kagan/Sivashinsky 2023-2026) has self-drifting 2D flame balls and flamelets from disintegrating near-limit fronts, now with Boussinesq buoyancy; split flame cells are reported in experiments (Veiga-Lopez 2020, excerpt only). c49's reacting thermals are therefore a variant: new is a tracked population on regrowing fuel with lineages and motion between births and fissions. Soto & Golestanian 2014 is the nearest work to c33's phoretic composites (assembly plus spontaneous motion). For C:minority-swimmers-spread, spatial sorting (Shine et al. 2011) and its post-expansion trade-off prediction (Perkins et al. 2016) give a new selective environment for c45's Marangoni ladder.
